title: Implication
summary: Implication connects a condition to what follows from it.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared propositional language context is fixed.

content.plain: Implication connects a condition to what follows from it.
content.exact: P→Q is a binary connective. Classical material implication, constructive implication, and entailment are related but distinct notions.
content.example: ‘If n is divisible by 4, then n is even.’
content.caveat: P→Q inside a language is not the same object as Γ⊢Q or Γ⊨Q.
